description: Algoma is an AI-native real estate development platform that helps real estate developers turn an address into a deal. Algoma’s software accelerates decision-making for real estate developers by delivering site feasibility in minutes. By combining market intelligence, zoning analysis, capacity calculations, construction cost data, and pro forma modeling, Algoma gives developers the confidence to make go/no-go decisions faster and at a fraction of the typical cost.

BuildCrew.AI is the workspace where construction teams collaborate alongside AI colleagues. Our Digital Interns handle ROM estimating, bid leveling, and issue detection. Turning days of complex preconstruction work into minutes by putting you on third base. Drop in any drawings and other supporting documents, any size. Results come back human-quality for your final go

CemVision team is re-inventing cement, replacing everything that’s bad about it with a product that is economical, circular, environmentally friendly, and technically superior. Their proprietary technology utilises industrial by-products from steelmaking and mining (basically recycled industrial waste) instead of virgin limestone, and electrifies the heating production process turning cement into a sustainable material
Year invested | 2022 Headquarters | Quito, Ecuador First Partnered | Seed
CONXAI's construction-aware AI analyzes and interprets your data to give you the insight you need, when you need it

CURA is a Canadian climate tech company developing electrochemical technology to reduce CO2 emissions from cement production. Its CURALYTETM-powered electrolyzer cuts emissions by up to 85% while lowering energy use and manufacturing cost. Designed as a retrofit-ready solution, CURA’s technology integrates with existing feedstocks, infrastructure, and operations.

Gravis Robotics is a construction autonomy startup focused on revolutionizing earthmoving automation using advanced robotics software. Spun out of ETH Zurich, after 10 years of core tech research, their core technology enables seamless collaboration between excavators, humans, and the environment. This improves operator safety, increases productivity, and helps address low equipment utilization.

N Robotics plays at the intersection of Robotics and AI, developing fully autonomous robots with flexible payloads to collect, understand, and analyse data on jobsites and industrial facilities. Their 4-wheeled and bipedal robots are paired with different payloads and powerful AI capabilities

AI-native preconstruction software that maps organizational expertise to deploy intelligent agents across complex construction projects. The company’s platform leverages a proprietary knowledge graph to orchestrate task execution and decision-making with AI agents. This enables teams to identify risks earlier, detect inconsistencies across disciplines, and make better decisions during pre-construction—where project outcomes are defined.

RDash moves construction teams from fragmented silos to AI-orchestrated execution by creating a shared memory and workflow layer across design, procurement, finance and site teams. RDash AI agents analyse costs and vendor invoices, automate reporting, follow up across teams, and flag risks to keep project on track

Safety Bolt transforms infrastructure maintenance with a wireless structural integrity monitoring platform that retrofits onto existing bolts in under a minute. Its patented strain sensors track load changes in real time, delivering up to 20 years of live data to predict failures before they happen and significantly reduce unplanned downtime across wind energy, infrastructure, mining and defense.

Track3D ensures that every detail is tracked, progress is monitored, significantly reducing costly reworks and delays.
